Zarr.name: Zarr
Zarr.description: Unload a barrage of explosives or a huge shot of flak from this cannon's enormous barrel.

Javlok.name: Javlok
Javlok.description: Launch super-heated slugs at individual foes, or hurl the entire weapon and ignite groups of enemies in a flash inferno.

Quartakk.name: Quartakk
Quartakk.description: Annihilate targets with four simultaneous shots from this high-caliber Grineer rifle.

Buzlok.name: Buzlok
Buzlok.description: Mark your targets and then unleash a barrage of bullets, the Buzlok's homing rounds always find the enemy. Marked Targets are more likely to take critical hits.

Tonkor.name: Tonkor
Tonkor.description: Hurl mayhem and destruction with this Grineer grenade launcher.

Harpak.name: Harpak
Harpak.description: Spike enemies to the wall or reel them in with this automatic harpoon gun.

Kuva Chakkhurr.name: Kuva Chakkhurr
Kuva Chakkhurr.description: Detonate heads with this slow-firing rifle that rewards precision.

Gotva Prime.name: Gotva Prime
Gotva Prime.description: Long before clone-rot set in, elite Grineer Commanders protected the surviving Orokin from rebelling Warframes with these formidable rifles. When Gotva Prime inflicts a Status Effect its next shot has a chance to be a Super Critical hit.

Kohm.description: For every shot fired in rapid succession the Kohm releases an additional bolt and grows more lethal.

Higasa.description: Depend on Higasa when it rains bullets. Aiming creates a shield that blocks weapon fire. Kills and blocked shots charge a beam released by Alternate Fire.

Alternox.description: Gyre's signature weapon has two fire modes. Primary fire shocks enemies with electrical orbs. Alternate fire is a large ball of electricity that sticks to any surface and pulses Electricity before it explodes. In Gyre's hands, this weapon has a small amount of multishot.

Bubonico.description: Rain down a triple volley of explosive disease bladders from a distance, then move in for the kill by unloading a multi-shot barrage of toxic barbs with primary fire.

Mutalist Quanta.name: Mutalist Quanta
Mutalist Quanta.description: A bizarre union of Corpus technology and Infested biology, this automatic rifle can also deploy an irradiated airborne infested mass. Further field testing is required to fully understand the potential of this weapon.

Paracyst.name: Paracyst
Paracyst.description: Completely overwhelmed by Infested biology, this former Quanta now fires organic ordinance and a harpoon like appendage.

Sporothrix.description: This long-distance sniper rifle fires a razor-sharp, virus-soaked barb that continues to attack its host before violently erupting in a spore-laden mist. Scoped headshots increase lethality.

Mutalist Cernos.name: Mutalist Cernos
Mutalist Cernos.description: Overcome with Infestation, this bow's arrows now spread poisonous contagion to any surface they hit.

Hema.description: A bloodsucker. This symbiotic burst-rifle leeches health to forge its ammo and then restores health with each headshot.

Synapse.name: Synapse
Synapse.description: Powered by a bio-chemical reaction, the infested Synapse rifle fries its targets with a steady stream of Corrosive energy.

Phage.name: Phage
Phage.description: Fires seven beams of continuous biochemical energy which depletes the life from any surface they contact.

Artemis Bow.name: Artemis Bow
Artemis Bow.description: Summon a mighty bow and unleash a volley of devastating arrows. Energy Drain Per Shot: 15

Karak Wraith.name: Karak Wraith
Karak Wraith.description: A different take on the Grineer assault rifle, the Karak Wraith features unique styling.

Kuva Drakgoon.name: Kuva Drakgoon
Kuva Drakgoon.description: The Kuva Drakgoon flak cannon sends volleys of intensely hot shrapnel ricocheting around the room that do not slow down. Larger Magazine Capacity and Reload Speed. Can be fired in wide or concentrated bursts.

Kuva Bramma.description: This Grineer bow delivers vengeance in the form of cluster bomb-tipped arrows that can be detonated mid-air or on impact. Low quiver capacity, arrows are recovered singly.

Kuva Hek.name: Kuva Hek
Kuva Hek.description: Forged at the behest of the Worm Queen herself, this already powerful shotgun now has the additional ability to fire from all four barrels simultaneously.

Kuva Hind.name: Kuva Hind
Kuva Hind.description: This powerful Grineer burst rifle has been retrofitted to add semi-automatic and automatic firing modes.

Kuva Kohm.description: The Kuva Kohm variant has a higher fire rate than the original. For every shot fired in succession the Kuva Kohm releases an additional bolt and grows more lethal.

Kuva Ogris.description: The custom weapon of a fearsome Kuva Lich. Unlike the basic version the Kuva Ogris fires detonite-infused casing semi-automatically, from a smaller magazine, while dealing greater damage per shot

Kuva Quartakk.description: Unlike a standard Quartakk this Kuva Lich variant fires automatically from the hip while retaining its signature feature when aimed: annihilating targets with four simultaneous shots.

Kuva Sobek.name: Kuva Sobek
Kuva Sobek.description: The Kuva Sobek's exceptional Reload Speed, Critical Chance, and Status Chance make it a natural fit for the Kuva Lich's dominant spirit.

Kuva Tonkor.name: Kuva Tonkor
Kuva Tonkor.description: This Lich-variant grenade launcher hurls mayhem and destruction with an increased Reload Speed.

Kuva Zarr.description: An even stronger Zarr cannon to meet the demands of Kuva Liches. With stronger explosive barrages, and long-range flak shots.

Laser Rifle.description: A laser rifle developed by reverse-engineering Corpus technology.

Prime Laser Rifle.name: Prime Laser Rifle

Catchmoon (Secondary).description: Secondary: Fires a wide-radius plasma energy projectile with a very short half-life. Primary: Automatic trigger, faster fire rate and smaller projectiles.

Gaze (Secondary).name: Gaze (Secondary)
Gaze (Secondary).description: Secondary: a persistent cutting beam of pure energy. Primary: same as Secondary, but with explosion on impact.

Tombfinger (Secondary).name: Tombfinger (Secondary)
Tombfinger (Secondary).description: Secondary: fires projectiles semi-automatically with high accuracy; area-of-effect explosion on impact. Primary: hold fire to charge for an even greater effect.

Sporelacer (Secondary).name: Sporelacer (Secondary)
Sporelacer (Secondary).description: Primary: Launches spore-sacs that explode with toxic mist on each bounce. Automatic trigger. Secondary: Fires spore-sacs that rupture into three smaller toxic projectiles on impact. Semi-automatic trigger.

Vermisplicer (Secondary).name: Vermisplicer (Secondary)
Vermisplicer (Secondary).description: Long-range proboscis attaches to a target and then splits off to attack up to three more enemies. Secondary: Three short-range proboscises fiercely latch onto targets and maul them.

Balefire Charger.name: Balefire Charger
Balefire Charger.description: Charges up and releases bolts of Balefire.

Dex Pixia.name: Dex Pixia
Dex Pixia.description: Take flight with Razorwing and summon these mighty dual pistols.

Glory.name: Glory
Glory.description: Unleash the power of the Jade Light.

Grimoire.name: Grimoire
Grimoire.description: Claim the power of Abrecht Entrati's knowledge. Customize the Grimoire with Tome Mods that enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat. Its alternate attack releases a voltaic orb with guaranteed Electricity Status.

Regulators.name: Regulators
Regulators.description: The Regulators are Mesa and Mesa Prime's signature Exalted Weapon, summoned by activating the ability Peacemaker. Unlike other ranged weapons, the rapid-firing Regulators will automatically target and shoot at enemies within a large aiming circle directed by the player, removing the need for precise aim.

Sepulcrum.name: Sepulcrum
Sepulcrum.description: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating alt fire. This large, weighty double-barreled pistol delivers twin projectiles that pack a punch, exploding on impact. Alt fire puts the weapon in lock-on mode. Aim to lock onto multiple targets, then fire to unleash homing missiles.

Tenet Diplos.name: Tenet Diplos
Tenet Diplos.description: Itemize and execute with this pair of auto-lock-on, homing-projectile pistols. Shoot from the hip for a more conventional pistol experience. The patented Granum Attaché System reloads the pistols when holstered.

Noctua.name: Noctua
Noctua.description: | strength = 175 / 200 / 225 / 250 base Slash damage on primary fire2,000 / 2,250 / 2,500 / 2,750 base Radiation damage on alt-fire

Telos Boltace.name: Telos Boltace
Telos Boltace.description: Spinning attacks unleash the Stormpath, a tempest of mayhem that hurls any foes in its way

Ankyros Prime.name: Ankyros Prime
Ankyros Prime.description: This Orokin variation of the Ankyros is superior to its successor in every way.

Paracesis.name: Paracesis
Paracesis.description: Take this... the idea of it... it is the only way your [[The New War

Valkyr Talons.name: Valkyr Talons
Valkyr Talons.description: These talons emerge when Valkyr unleashes her Hysteria.

Bo Prime.name: Bo Prime

Perk 1: Stalwart Oak: Increase Damage by +110 (Bo) / +90 (MK1) / +34 (Prime). While Armor is greater than 450: +30 Parry Angle and +300% Combo Count Chance while Blocking.

2.description: Perk 2: Swordsman's Flourish: Increase Damage by +100 (Bo) / +85 (MK1) / +30 (Prime). With Melee Weapon Equipped: +100% Combo Count Chance.

2.description: Perk 2: Overhand: Base Heavy Attack Efficiency set to 20%.

3.description: Perk 3: Swordsman's Celerity: +20% Movement Speed (Permanently active)

2.description: Perk 2: Subtle Force: Increase Critical Chance by +12% (Bo) / +15% (MK1) / +6% (Prime). Increase Status Chance by +12% (Bo) / +15% (MK1) / +6% (Prime).

3.description: Perk 3: Absolute Dominion: Increase Status Chance by +34% (Bo) / +38% (MK1) / +30% (Prime).

Bo Prime.description: A classic Orokin weapon, Bo Prime creates elegant fury on the battlefield.

Boltace.name: Boltace
Boltace.description: An intimidating Tonfa set designed to match the briary design of the Boltor.

Kogake.name: Kogake
Kogake.description: These coverings for the hands and feet allow devastating high flying hand-to-hand combat attacks without risking harm to the user.

Tekko.name: Tekko
Tekko.description: These iron fists that rip through foes are Atlas' signature weapons. When wielded by Atlas they receive a Status Chance increase.

Synoid Heliocor.name: Synoid Heliocor
Synoid Heliocor.description: This intelligent hammer takes an enemy killed by a Heavy Attack and recomposes them as an ally. Any fatal strike with this weapon also performs a Codex scan.

Heliocor.name: Heliocor
Heliocor.description: Obtain enlightenment with this massive hammer that performs a Codex scan on each fatal strike. Scans require equipped Codex Scanner and an available charge.

Ceramic Dagger.name: Ceramic Dagger

1.description: Reach 6x Combo then Heavy Attack to activate Incarnon Form. +100% Melee Damage, +25% Sprint Speed, +25% Bullet Jump.
Perk 1: Gun and Blade: Increase Damage by +100. On Primary Kill: +1 Initial Combo. Stacks up to 100x.

2.description: Perk 2: Breacher's Opportunity: Increase Damage by +120. On Shield Break: Increase damage by +80 for 8s.

2.description: Perk 2: Adept Reflexes: +20 Initial Combo.

3.description: Perk 3: Rogue Readiness: On Kill: 40% chance to instantly reload Primary and Secondary weapons.

3.description: Perk 3: Absolute Valor: Increase Critical Chance by +30% .

Ceramic Dagger.description: This short blade weapon was built using ceramic. It has limited range but comes out fast.

Cobra & Crane Prime.name: Cobra & Crane Prime
Cobra & Crane Prime.description: Punish those who test your restraint. The first strike in a combo stuns enemies when Cobra & Crane Prime are wielded by Baruuk.

Serro.name: Serro
Serro.description: Developed as an energy saw to scrap obsolete ships, this tool was quickly banned when rebels in the Sedna region discovered it also made an excellent weapon.

Obex.name: Obex

1.description: Reach 6x Combo then Heavy Attack to activate Incarnon Form. +100% Melee Damage, +20% Sprint Speed, +20% Parkour Velocity.
Perk 1: Balanced Stagger: Increase Base Damage by +50 (Obex) / +10 (Prisma). 20% chance to stun enemies hit by a Neutral Combo, opening them to finishers.

2.description: Perk 2: Armored Finisher: Increase Base Damage by +50 (Obex) / +10 (Prisma). With Armor Over 450: +80% Finisher Damage.

1.description: Perk 1: Rapid Conclusion: On Finisher Kill: +2.5% Parkour Velocity. Stacks up to 16x.

2.description: Perk 2: Orokin Reach: +1.2 Range

3.description: Perk 3: Standoff: Combo Timer pauses when weapon is holstered.

2.description: Perk 2: Absolute Dominion: Increase Status Chance by +28 (Obex) / +20% (Prime) %.

3.description: Perk 3: Critical Coefficient: Increase Base Critical Damage Multiplier by +0.6x. Effect doubles in Incarnon Form.

Obex.description: The Obex system multiplies the kinetic energy of a Tenno's kicks and punches, delivering deadly blows to any target.

Ohma.name: Ohma
Ohma.description: Bring the enemy to its knees with these twin electrified tonfas.

Lecta.name: Lecta
Lecta.description: Half taser, half whip. The Corpus Lecta, delivers a deadly shock to anything it touches.

Dakra Prime.name: Dakra Prime
Dakra Prime.description: The Dakra Prime is a Tenno forged weapon, crafted during the Time of the Orokin. It is renowned for speed, power and the ability to hit multiple targets.

Cronus.name: Cronus
Cronus.description: A strong blade forged using ceramic.

Tenet Exec.name: Tenet Exec
Tenet Exec.description: Leverage bleeding-edge Granum tech with this massive heavy blade. Slam sends forth a cascading set of three shockwaves, while Heavy Slam unleashes a swath of shockwaves.

Tenet Grigori.name: Tenet Grigori
Tenet Grigori.description: On Heavy Slide Attack this Corpus scythe launches a spinning energy disk that ricochets throughout the battlefield. Its lifetime is derived from the size of the Combo Counter. Note: The Granum Attaché system pauses the combo timer when holstered.

Tenet Livia.name: Tenet Livia
Tenet Livia.description: The sleek lines of the Granum Attaché case conceal an infinitely sharp two-handed blade. Blocked attacks have a chance to increase the blocking angle. Note: The Granum Attaché system pauses the combo timer when holstered.

Xoris.name: Xoris
Xoris.description: An obscure glaive weapon of Corpus provenance, intrinsically linked to Specter technology. The Xoris strikes rapidly and with great devastation. It is capable of chaining combos infinitely.

Falcor.name: Falcor
Falcor.description: Carve through enemies with surgical precision using this Corpus-tech glaive.

Stropha.name: Stropha
Stropha.description: A short-blade melee weapon with an ace up its sleeve. Send nearby enemies flying with a short-range shockwave.

Arca Titron.name: Arca Titron
Arca Titron.description: Each successive kill from this massive electron hammer builds an electron charge that is unleashed on with slam attacks.

Tenet Agendus.name: Tenet Agendus
Tenet Agendus.description: Drive the agenda with this massive impact hammer. Heavy attacks launch devastating energy disks.

Galvacord.name: Galvacord
Galvacord.description: Shock and maim with this heavyweight retractable whip.

Kreska.name: Kreska
Kreska.description: This unsophisticated Corpus survival tool does what it was designed for: hacking and splitting whatever it strikes

Nami Skyla.name: Nami Skyla
Nami Skyla.description: Like the surge and crash of storm waves, a master of the Nami cutlass and Skyla dagger turns these two separate weapons into one fluid attack.

Dark Sword.name: Dark Sword
Dark Sword.description: A blade forged using dark metals, capable of delivering high-damage charge attacks.

Edun.name: Edun
Edun.description: Edun befits a dexterous warrior. Heavy Attack to throw Edun. Edun explodes after it is embedded in an enemy.

Sampotes.name: Sampotes
Sampotes.description: A warrior who prefers brute force will make the most of Sampotes. Its Slams and Heavy Slams have an extended area of effect.

Argo & Vel.name: Argo & Vel
Argo & Vel.description: Argo & Vel bolster the warrior who stands fast. Its Heavy Attack sends forth a glaive that ricochets off enemies.

Syam.name: Syam
Syam.description: Syam is at home in the hands of a focused warrior. Its Heavy Attacks send forth shockwaves.

Azothane.name: Azothane
Azothane.description: Azothane calls the visionary warrior to turn the tides of battle. Block and melee attack at the same time to plunge Azothane into the ground, damaging nearby enemies with a shockwave and adding to the combo counter.

Destreza Prime.name: Destreza Prime

1.description: Reach 6x Combo then Heavy Attack to activate Incarnon Form. +100% Melee Damage, +20% Sprint Speed, +20% Parkour Velocity. +10% Puncture Damage per Heavy Attack kill, up to 300% while transformed.
Perk 1: Weighted Impetus: Increase Base Damage by +50. On Heavy Attack Kill: +100% Heavy Attack Wind Up Speed for 8s.

2.description: Perk 2: Piercing Stature: Increase Base Damage by +50. On Puncture Status Effect: Gain +20% Status Chance for 6 seconds. Stacks 5x.

2.description: Perk 2: Overhand: Base Heavy Attack Efficiency set to 30%.

3.description: Perk 3: Adept Reflexes: +20 Initial Combo

2.description: Perk 2: Critical Forte: Increase Critical Damage Multiplier by +1.2x (Destreza) / +0.6x (Prime).

3.description: Perk 3: Decisive Stature: Increase Base Critical Chance by 25% of current Status Chance, up to 35%.

Destreza Prime.description: Take mastery to the next level with this primed rapier.

Dex Dakra.name: Dex Dakra
Dex Dakra.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the awakening of the first Tenno from Cryo stasis.

Dex Nikana.name: Dex Nikana
Dex Nikana.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the eleventh anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.

Gazal Machete.name: Gazal Machete
Gazal Machete.description: Each kill with this swooping blade adds bonus corrosive damage to the Djinn Sentinel’s next Fatal Attraction cast. In turn, each Fatal Attraction cast by the sentinel bestows the weapon with a period of corrosive damage.

Dragon Nikana.name: Dragon Nikana
Dragon Nikana.description: The Dragon Nikana is forged from ancient Tenno steel. This is a master's weapon, only the most worthy of Tenno may wield it.

Sirocco.name: Sirocco
Sirocco.description: A silent pistol for infiltrations and assassinations. Generates its own ammunition from Void energy. A precisely timed reload over-charges the next shot.

Dual Zoren.name: Dual Zoren
Dual Zoren.description: Short axes held in each hand. High attack speed and can hit multiple targets. Delivers a high percentage of critical strikes.

Fang.name: Fang
Fang.description: These matching stilettos have increased attack speed and can unleash a flurry of multi-hit attacks.

Ether Daggers.name: Ether Daggers
Ether Daggers.description: A shorter version of the Ether blade that allows for a more focused attack on a single target.

Dual Ether.name: Dual Ether
Dual Ether.description: Fast and precise. The Dual Ether cuts so cleanly that it was considered by the Tenno to be a more humane weapon for 'cleansing' infested allies. Capable of hitting multiple targets.

Twin Krohkur.name: Twin Krohkur
Twin Krohkur.description: Battlefield butchery becomes all too easy with a Krohkur blade in each hand.

Dual Heat Swords.name: Dual Heat Swords
Dual Heat Swords.description: With a Heat Sword in each hand, enemies reach their fiery demise twice as fast. Can connect with multiple targets at once.

Dual Kamas.name: Dual Kamas
Dual Kamas.description: Wielding a Kama in each hand brings a savage amount of slash damage to bear against your enemies.

Dual Kamas Prime.name: Dual Kamas Prime
Dual Kamas Prime.description: The sensual lines of these golden Kamas have long been celebrated as a masterwork of Tenno weapon smithing.

Dual Keres Prime.name: Dual Keres Prime
Dual Keres Prime.description: The hunted will meet a quick end when faced with Khora Prime’s signature swords. Heavy Attack Efficiency is enhanced when wielded by Khora.

Dual Skana.name: Dual Skana
Dual Skana.description: A shorter Skana in each hand. Can hit multiple targets.

Hespar.name: Hespar
Hespar.description: This Heavy Scythe echoes battles of another time. It is far more a weapon of sheer force than one of finesse.

Ekhein.name: Ekhein
Ekhein.description: Wield the timeless power of this mighty hammer. Heavy Attacks performed with Ekhein temporarily increase its Damage and Attack Speed.

Ruvox.name: Ruvox

2.description: Perk 2: Lethal Impetus: On Kill: +15% Attack Speed for 15s. Stacks up to 3x.

3.description: Perk 3: Gathering Momentum: Gain +5% Movement Speed per Melee Combo Multiplier

2.description: Perk 2: Seismic Slam: +60% Slam Radius

3.description: Perk 3: Adept Reflexes: +20 Initial Combo

2.description: Perk 2: Ternary Vault : Gain +1 mid-air jumps

3.description: Perk 3: Inspiring Execution : +30% Combo Count Chance on Finishers for 20s

2.description: Perk 2: Vulnerability Serum : Impaled enemies are +35% more vulnerable to Status Chance

3.description: Perk 3: Permanent Perforation : Enemies suffer 5 Puncture Status while impaled

Ruvox.description: Albrecht's Void experiments revealed the true destructive potential of this fist weapon. In Incarnon form, perform Heavy Slams to impale nearby enemies with spikes.

Ether Reaper.name: Ether Reaper
Ether Reaper.description: With a blade forged from the same material as the Ether Sword, the Ether Reaper delivers quick death to its victims.

Ether Sword.name: Ether Sword
Ether Sword.description: A single blade for more precision. The Ether Sword cuts so cleanly that it was considered by the Tenno to be a more humane weapon for 'cleansing' infested allies.

Fang Prime.name: Fang Prime
Fang Prime.description: A set of ceremonial daggers from the Orokin era, the Fang Prime's blades resonate violently as they strike. This allows them to pierce hardened materials like armor with ease.

Furax.name: Furax

Perk 1: Swordsman's Flourish: Increase Damage by +110 (Furax) / +100 (MK1) / +65 (Wraith). With Melee Weapon Equipped: +100% Combo Count Chance

2.description: Perk 2: Kill Joy: Increase Damage by +90 (Furax) / +80 (MK1) / +55 (Wraith). +10% Attack Speed per enemy within 6m, stacks up to 5x.

Diwata.name: Diwata

Tonbo.name: Tonbo
Tonbo.description: During the darkest days of the Old War many a Tenno relied solely on the Tonbo to keep them alive.

Fragor Prime.name: Fragor Prime
Fragor Prime.description: A beautifully forged instrument of devastation.

Furax Wraith.name: Furax Wraith

Furax Wraith.description: These Wraith gauntlets have been augmented for power.

Galatine Prime.name: Galatine Prime
Galatine Prime.description: Only Tenno were strong enough to wield this noble beast of a weapon.

Shattered Lash.name: Shattered Lash
Shattered Lash.description: Lash out with stream of shattered glass, or hold for an arcing strike. Stats are boosted by the equipped melee weapon's mods.

Garuda Talons.name: Garuda Talons
Garuda Talons.description: These nasty things come out when Garuda forgoes a melee weapon.

Garuda Prime Talons.name: Garuda Prime Talons
Garuda Prime Talons.description: These nasty things come out when Garuda Prime forgoes a melee weapon.

Glaive Prime.name: Glaive Prime
Glaive Prime.description: The Glaive Prime is a deadly and beautiful weapon from the Orokin era. The blades are as effective in close quarters as they are when thrown at distant enemies.

Volnus.name: Volnus
Volnus.description: Tear and maim with this agile, lightweight glass hammer. When Gara wields her signature melee weapon, it gains additional Slam Radial Damage.

Gram Prime.name: Gram Prime
Gram Prime.description: Born anew, the father of swords returns.

Gram.name: Gram
Gram.description: The heavy two-handed sword known as Gram requires great strength to wield, but is notorious for its splitting power. Can hit multiple targets with each strike.

Sheev.name: Sheev
Sheev.description: Tenno, You have gone above and beyond. The Grineer are on the defense. Their supply of void keys is dwindling. To recognize your sacrifice I am giving you this weapon. Use it to defend the balance.

Dual Cleavers.name: Dual Cleavers
Dual Cleavers.description: Butcher your foes with brutal blades in each hand.

Jat Kittag.name: Jat Kittag
Jat Kittag.description: Deliver crushing blows with this Grineer built, jet powered mace.

Machete.name: Machete
Machete.description: A ferocious melee weapon crafted by the Grineer and carried by their elite melee forces.

Amphis.name: Amphis
Amphis.description: Fashioned with Grineer materials and balanced for marine infantry use, the Amphis is a traditional staff weapon that has received a monstrous makeover that enables shock damage on jump attacks. Connects with multiple enemies with each strike.

Halikar.name: Halikar
Halikar.description: This jet-powered Grineer throwing mace always comes back to its owner and is even capable of disarming targets.

Ripkas.name: Ripkas
Ripkas.description: Originally a tool for cutting apart scrap metal or overgrown wildlife, this weapon blends convenience, efficiency, and callous brutality into a single package.

Twin Basolk.name: Twin Basolk
Twin Basolk.description: These nasty, little hatchets slice through steel as if it were flesh.

Krohkur.name: Krohkur
Krohkur.description: This hooked blade rewards critical hits to those skilled enough to strike with finesse.

Ghoulsaw.name: Ghoulsaw
Ghoulsaw.description: The cruelest of weapons built for the crudest of Grineer soldiers. Rips through metal like flesh, and through flesh like day-old pudding.

Vastilok.name: Vastilok
Vastilok.description: Slash and blast with this heavy Gunblade of brutal Grineer design. High slash damage paired with a heavy shotgun attack.

Kesheg.name: Kesheg
Kesheg.description: Slice through mobs of unruly enemies with this fierce halberd; the signature weapon of the Kuva Guardians.

Jat Kusar.name: Jat Kusar
Jat Kusar.description: Overwhelm hostiles with this jet-powered sickle and razor-chain weapon. Charged strikes ignite an explosive blast at range.

Broken Scepter.name: Broken Scepter
Broken Scepter.description: A shattered talisman of the Grineer Elder Queen. It pulls health orbs from deceased enemies and energy orbs from destroyed robots.

Slaytra.name: Slaytra
Slaytra.description: The Slaytra is a powerful reiteration of the Grineer Machete that doubles the duration of bleed from slash damage.

Korrudo.name: Korrudo
Korrudo.description: When they go high, go low. Powerful pneumatic grips and toecaps amplify every blow. Four ways to deal twice the pain.

Sydon.name: Sydon
Sydon.description: Inflict maximum devastation with this massive Grineer trident.

Atterax.name: Atterax
Atterax.description: A multi-bladed whip that is adept at flaying skin from bone. In extreme cases, disobedient Grineer are sentenced to death by Atterax.

Guandao Prime.name: Guandao Prime
Guandao Prime.description: That a god might reap a harvest of lives.

Gunsen Prime.name: Gunsen Prime
Gunsen Prime.description: Command the beauty and lethality of these ornate fans.

Halikar Wraith.name: Halikar Wraith
Halikar Wraith.description: A different take on the throwing mace, the Halikar Wraith features unique styling.

Fragor.name: Fragor
Fragor.description: A large two-handed hammer, the Fragor requires great strength to wield, but impacts with enough force to send groups of enemies tumbling.

Heat Dagger.name: Heat Dagger
Heat Dagger.description: This short blade weapon has limited range but comes out fast and can inflict fire damage.

Heat Sword.name: Heat Sword
Heat Sword.description: A strong blade capable of inflicting fire damage to its foes.

Scindo.name: Scindo
Scindo.description: The Scindo is a heavy war axe crafted by the Tenno. Reduced speed and agility is balanced by heavy, devastating strikes capable of connecting with multiple targets at once.

Sibear.name: Sibear

1.description: Reach 6x Combo then Heavy Attack to activate Incarnon Form. +100% Melee Damage, +50% Heavy Attack Efficiency, +10% Sprint Speed, +10% Bullet Jump.
Perk 1: Master's Shatter: Increase Damage by +20. 10 additional Combo on targets affected by Cold Status.

2.description: Perk 2: Thane's Wrath: Increase Damage by +20. With Armor Over 450: Increase Damage by +40.

2.description: Perk 2: Kinetic Harmony: +60% Heavy Attack Wind Up Speed.

3.description: Perk 3: Resolute Force: +6s Combo Duration.

3.description: Perk 3: Red Right Hand : On First Attack With Primary Equipped: Increase Critical Damage Multiplier by +2x . First attack from quickswap melee deals bonus critical damage.

Sibear.description: Ice in motion can crush mountains, this frozen hammer is no different.

Pathocyst.name: Pathocyst
Pathocyst.description: Each strike of this infested glaive infects its target with viral pathogens. Occasionally, it discharges the spores of rabid, enemy-seeking maggots, either in-flight or on contact with an enemy.

Caustacyst.name: Caustacyst
Caustacyst.description: Charge attacks from this scythe unleash a wave of acid that mutilates enemies and leaves a trail of corrosive sludge.

Pulmonars.name: Pulmonars
Pulmonars.description: Pummel and infect with these two pulsating hunks of flesh connected by a ligament. Take-hold of the malignant evolution of an ancient martial weapon.

Pupacyst.name: Pupacyst
Pupacyst.description: A two-pronged attack; the bone-grafted cocoon at the tip of this polearm rends flesh, while the viral mass living within spreads itself into the wounds of each new victim.

Keratinos.name: Keratinos
Keratinos.description: Leave your mark with these infected claws with increased heavy attack range. Heavy attack at max combo to keep the extended range and slam radius for three minutes.

Arum Spinosa.name: Arum Spinosa

Nepheri.description: The dual flaming fang-blades of the Archon Amar. Has a unique Neutral Combo that blasts out four short-range fireballs.

Quassus.name: Quassus
Quassus.description: Flick away the enemy with this heavy warfan. The Quassus scatters ethereal daggers that are even more deadly accurate when wielded by Xaku.

Sampotes.name: Sampotes
Sampotes.description: A warrior who prefers brute force will make the most of Sampotes. Its Slams and Heavy Slams have an extended area of effect.

Sigma & Octantis.name: Sigma & Octantis
Sigma & Octantis.description: Deadly slashes from the Sigma sword are matched only by the force of the Octantis shield when thrown from the air.

Syam.name: Syam
Syam.description: Syam is at home in the hands of a focused warrior. Its Heavy Attacks send forth shockwaves.

Tatsu.name: Tatsu
Tatsu.description: Fearsome and noble, the elegant two-handed Nikana is the pride of any Arsenal. Kills build charges and seeking projectiles are unleashed with a Slide Attack to find and stun unwitting enemies. When Revenant wields this blade, Tatsu's charge cap is increased.

Telos Boltace.name: Telos Boltace

Tenet Agendus.name: Tenet Agendus
Tenet Agendus.description: Drive the agenda with this massive impact hammer. Heavy attacks launch devastating energy disks.

Tenet Exec.name: Tenet Exec
Tenet Exec.description: Leverage bleeding-edge Granum tech with this massive heavy blade. Slam sends forth a cascading set of three shockwaves, while Heavy Slam unleashes a swath of shockwaves.

Tenet Grigori.name: Tenet Grigori
Tenet Grigori.description: On Heavy Slide Attack this Corpus scythe launches a spinning energy disk that ricochets throughout the battlefield. Its lifetime is derived from the size of the Combo Counter. Note: The Granum Attaché system pauses the combo timer when holstered.

Verdilac.name: Verdilac
Verdilac.description: Archon Nira’s spine-shattering whip. Has a unique Tactical Combo that whips out a wide wave of energy with each stroke.

Vitrica.name: Vitrica
Vitrica.description: The sword the fabled Orokin executioner Nihil used to glass the condemned. Swing while Aim Gliding to glass enemies. A Ground Slam will smash nearby glassed foes, while sending forward a narrow shockwave to shatter distant ones. A Heavy Slam sends forth a wider shockwave with greater force.

Zenistar.name: Zenistar
Zenistar.description: Scorch enemies with blistering blows, or set them ablaze with the flying fire disc.

Hysteria.name: Hysteria
